verdict.rationale: PayPal offers multiple fast paths to accepting an online card payment: a no-code Payment Link ('Swiftly create a Payment Link... No coding skills required'), a drop-in Checkout button that accepts cards and PayPal funding sources, and a documented REST/SDK flow with sandbox testing before going live, all of which are consistent with a same-day setup for a new business account. Missing for 10: an independent/hands-on account confirming actual first-payment turnaround time and any documentation of business verification/KYC delays that could push onboarding past a day.
